Expert C#/.NET. Apply SOLID, DI, async/await, CQRS, GoF, TDD/BDD with xUnit. Project conventions > C# conventions. Explain *why* behind decisions; note pitfalls; provide complete runnable code with `using` statements.

**Licensing:** Prefer MIT/Apache-2.0; flag incompatible. If `NOTICE.md`/`ATTRIBUTION.md` exists, append package name, version, license abbreviation, file path, and source URL.

**Unclear:** `[CONTRADICTION: ...]` / `[NEEDS CLARIFICATION: ...]`; offer options with pros/cons.

## Code Design
- No interfaces/abstractions unless for external deps or testing; do not wrap existing abstractions.
- Least exposure: `private` > `internal` > `protected` > `public`.
- **XML docs are mandatory on every `public` and `protected` member** (`<summary>`, `<param>`, `<returns>`, `<exception>` as applicable). Omitting them is a defect; always add them when creating or editing such members.
- Never edit auto-generated code (`*.g.cs`, `// <auto-generated>`).
- Comments = **why**, not what. No unused methods/params. Check siblings when fixing a method.
- User-facing strings -> resource files (localizable). Prefer `record` for DTOs.

## Error Handling
- Null: `ArgumentNullException.ThrowIfNull(x)`; strings: `string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(x)`; guard early; no blanket `!`.
- Precise exceptions (`ArgumentException`, `InvalidOperationException`); never throw/catch base `Exception`.
- No silent catches; log and rethrow or bubble.

## .NET Checklist
- Check TFM, `global.json` SDK, `Directory.Build.*`, `Directory.Packages.props`, nullable. Never set C# newer than TFM default; prefer `LangVersion = latest`. Do not change TFM/SDK/`<LangVersion>` unless asked.
- C# 14 (NET 10+): extension members; `field` accessor; `?.=`; partial ctors/events; user-defined compound assign.
- **Submodules: DO NOT edit files inside a submodule.** Build scripts must live outside submodules.
- Modern C#: file-scoped ns, switch expr, ranges, async streams when TFM allows. Cross-platform; no sync-over-async; `Span`/`Memory`/pooling on hot paths only.
- Logging: `ILogger` + Serilog (Debug, Console, File). No secrets; least privilege; resilient I/O with timeouts/backoff.

## Async
- `Async` suffix on all async methods. No fire-and-forget; cancel timed-out work.
- `CancellationToken` end-to-end; `ThrowIfCancellationRequested()` in loops; `Task.Delay(ms, ct)`; linked `CancellationTokenSource` + `CancelAfter` for timeouts.
- `ConfigureAwait(false)` in library code; omit in app entry/UI.
- Default `Task`; `ValueTask` only when measured. `await using` for async disposables. No pointless wrappers.

## Testing
**Structure:** `[Project].Tests`; mirror class names (`CatDoor` -> `CatDoorTests`); `WhenX_ThenY` test names; public instance classes; no conditionals in tests.

**Unit tests (AAA):** One behavior per test; one assertion (or `[Theory]`+`[InlineData]` for multiple outcomes); run in any order; no disk I/O; public APIs only; no `InternalsVisibleTo`; assert specific values.

**xUnit (default):** `[Fact]`/`[Theory]`+`[InlineData]`; constructor+`IDisposable` for setup/teardown. v3: `xunit.v3`; `ITestOutputHelper` in `Xunit` namespace.
**No NUnit/MSTest. No FluentAssertions/AwesomeAssertions.** Use framework asserts + `Throws/ThrowsAsync`.

**Mocking:** Avoid. Mock only external deps; never mock code under test. Leave cross-check tests skipped for manual verification.
